title: Verify independently authorized Tarium enrollment preconditions
summary: Only after explicit authorization to enroll a named public repository, verify its independence, public constitution, documented ontology, human gallery, machine gallery index, licensing, public dependencies and accurate registry metadata before changing its Tarium membership entry.
statement: Only after explicit authorization to enroll a named public repository, verify its independence, public constitution, documented ontology, human gallery, machine gallery index, licensing, public dependencies and accurate registry metadata before changing its Tarium membership entry.
rationale: Tarium's public constitution defines a specialized, independently selectable project requirement. Overlap with general Nomos guidance is intentionally preserved and auditable.

conditions: The project owner explicitly authorized enrollment or registry modification of the named public repository.
exceptions: This rule does not authorize Tarium membership changes, private-material disclosure, or unrelated repository operations.

preconditions: The user has separately authorized the relevant project task; Tarium membership remains a separately approved operation.
exclusions: No automatic cross-repository action, enrollment, or publication of nonpublic source data.

authority.source: Tarium public governance, selected as optional project guidance

provenance.reference: https://github.com/sguzman/tarium/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md; CONSTITUTION.md Article II; GOVERNANCE.md; SPEC-0129; processing/specimens/PROC-SPEC-0129.json
provenance.notes: Public governance-based abstraction; no private source conversation retained. Rule publication does not create project membership or apply it to a repository.
